nodes.title: Clyde reserves the ranked batch; Gloo composes
nodes.summary: Code selects a bounded eligible prefix and records exact reserved IDs. Gloo can compose only those invitations; estimates do not guarantee coverage.

choices.label: Reserved batch receives valid Gloo copy
Selection, composition or source validation fails

nodes.title: Is batch outreach authorized and dispatched?
nodes.summary: The algorithm policy defaults false. Exact review, consent, recipient/session, quiet hours, source freshness and native transport checks remain required.

choices.label: Authorized reviewed offer successfully dispatched
Disabled, held, pending review or uncertain

nodes.title: An actual dispatched offer has a response deadline
nodes.summary: Each dispatched batch member has an immutable bounded response deadline. Queue/review time is excluded; a unique decline can select one replacement while other dispatched members wait.

choices.label: Actual YES arrives before expiry
Decline or expiry needs another candidate
Native outcome is uncertain

nodes.title: Freshly lock and recheck acceptance
nodes.summary: Only a real valid offer reply can claim the still-open slot; verify consent, eligibility, frequency and current event state again.

choices.label: Slot remains open and sender is eligible
Stale, late, duplicate or ineligible

nodes.title: Save the factual outcome
nodes.summary: A first eligible acceptance saves one assignment, closes sibling offers/reviews and supersedes queued sibling messages. Optional coverage may instead close the search without assignment.
nodes.end: Coverage reflects saved facts. Routine thanks/closure texts remain subject to current suppression policy.

nodes.title: Coordinator action is required
nodes.summary: Keep an unresolved cancellation, empty pool, late reply or uncertain delivery visible with the real reason.
nodes.end: No guessed assignment, duplicate offer or blind resend.

flows.title: What must be true before a text leaves?
flows.summary: This dependency view covers automatic Gloo-composed messages and exact-reviewed manual texts. A green step never grants permission to bypass the next gate.

nodes.title: Is there an allowed reason to contact this recipient?
nodes.summary: Essential missing intake, a real placement, a due reminder, requested booking status and internal admin updates have source requirements. Manual text uses exact human review.

choices.label: Purpose and source are allowed
Routine progress, completion or automatic offer prompt

nodes.title: Check consent, care and transport scope
nodes.summary: Require the permitted recipient and live session, with no opt-out or care hold. Sender-initiated pre-consent intake and control acknowledgments have narrow code-owned exceptions.

choices.label: All applicable recipient checks pass
Consent, care or enabled scope fails

nodes.title: Compose and validate the language
nodes.summary: Automatic text uses successful Gloo composition. Exact human-written manual copy follows its own review route. Neither route may invent facts.

choices.label: Required composition is valid, or exact manual copy is supplied
Required Gloo is missing, fails or returns invalid copy

nodes.title: Check literal facts and typography
nodes.summary: Reject em dash forms and invalid length. Literal approved workflows must match their exact required wording.

choices.label: Body is valid and unchanged
Body violates style or literal-copy requirements

nodes.title: Is every required review current?
nodes.summary: Bind approval to the actual recipient, body, source and expiry. Manual texts always require exact review; configured competition and restricted-role reviews also apply.

choices.label: Required approval is valid, or no review is required
Missing, stale, rejected or changed approval

nodes.title: Do timing and contact rules permit release?
nodes.summary: Respect church quiet hours, contact budgets and current source timing. A valid fresh inbound can permit only its own transactional response.

choices.label: Due now and within the permitted timing
Quiet hours or a not-yet-due time
Source expired or contact budget disallows it

nodes.title: Claim durably and recheck immediately before Messages
nodes.summary: Native preflight repeats source, scope, approval, consent and typography checks. Commit the attempt before the side effect.

choices.label: Matching native delivery evidence confirms delivery
Offline, changed facts or uncertain outcome

nodes.title: Record actual delivery evidence
nodes.summary: Queue acceptance and native submission are intermediate states. Only corresponding native evidence establishes delivery.
nodes.end: Store a private delivery receipt; do not claim carrier SMS from an iMessage result.

nodes.title: Persist a due-time hold
nodes.summary: Keep the message source and due time for a later recheck. Expired approvals or changed facts still require fresh work.
nodes.end: Wait without sending. A later authorized runtime tick must re-evaluate all applicable gates.

nodes.title: Hold or suppress with a specific reason
nodes.summary: Do not silently rewrite reviewed text, switch AI, broaden recipients or blindly resend an uncertain native attempt.
nodes.end: No delivery claim. Internal review or legitimate changed state is required.

flows.title: Day-before reminder and silence
flows.summary: The approved literal reminder describes an actual saved assignment. Not replying leaves that assignment in place.

nodes.title: Find a real approved or confirmed assignment
nodes.summary: Use the saved recipient, role, event and church timezone. Preferences or pending offers are not assignments.

choices.label: A genuine upcoming assignment exists
No real assignment exists

nodes.title: Is it the local day before the event?
nodes.summary: A thirty-second active scheduler can prepare assignments created later that day too. There is no morning-only cutoff.

choices.label: Yes, tomorrow is the event day
It is too early, event day or already past

nodes.title: Produce the approved literal reminder through Gloo
nodes.summary: Substitute only the actual recipient, serving role and local time. Require exact character-for-character output.

choices.label: Exact wording and facts match
Paraphrase, emoji, extra instructions, em dash or failure

nodes.title: Review the exact reminder
nodes.summary: A source-bound human review must remain valid. Superseded initial placement previews cannot create a duplicate day-before confirmation.

choices.label: Exact reminder approval is current
Review is missing, rejected or stale

nodes.title: Recheck before native delivery
nodes.summary: Require the assignment still exists, the person is eligible and consented, quiet hours/session permit it, and tomorrow still means the event.

choices.label: All checks pass and native evidence confirms delivery
Held into event day or any fact changes

nodes.title: What does the volunteer do afterward?
nodes.summary: The reminder says silence means the existing commitment remains. It does not require an extra confirmation reply.

choices.label: No reply or a simple acknowledgment
An actual cancellation arrives

nodes.title: Keep the existing assignment
nodes.summary: Silence never cancels the saved commitment and never creates an additional booking.
nodes.end: The original assignment remains unchanged.

nodes.title: Route the real cancellation
nodes.summary: Identify the exact assignment, reopen its slot and follow the current cancellation/replacement rules.
nodes.end: Cancellation logistics continue. Current automatic offer suppression still applies.

nodes.title: Do not release an invalid tomorrow text
nodes.summary: Keep the source for review or mark the reason it cannot send. Do not shift the clock or create an assignment to justify copy.
nodes.end: No reminder is sent from missing, stale or ineligible facts.

flows.title: Three-hour event digest for the coordinator
flows.summary: One concise status check per event start and saved active coordinator. It summarizes complete required coverage with an actionable next step.

nodes.title: Is connected scheduled work actually running?
nodes.summary: The real Mac, backend, bridge and scheduler must be active. A preview or saved settings form cannot run this workflow.

choices.label: Connected scheduler is active
Paused, offline or only a static preview

nodes.title: Is an active consenting admin recipient saved?
nodes.summary: Use configured coordinator recipients and their actual enabled scope. Do not send admin status to arbitrary volunteers.

choices.label: Admin is enrolled and eligible
No valid consenting admin is available

nodes.title: Has the event entered its three-hour window?
nodes.summary: Select scheduled future events at or within three hours of start. The notification expires at the event start.

choices.label: Within the window and still upcoming
Too early, closed or already started

nodes.title: Does this event-start and admin already have a receipt?
nodes.summary: Use a durable key containing event, coordinator and saved event start. Repeated ticks cannot create another copy.

choices.label: No receipt yet
Receipt already exists

nodes.title: Recompute all required staffing
nodes.summary: Count every required role and saved assignment, show open roles, restricted approvals and searches needing help. Missing recipes cannot mean fully staffed.

choices.label: Current coverage facts are available
Event source changed or necessary facts are invalid

nodes.title: Gloo writes a concise actionable summary
nodes.summary: Include event, coverage, blockers and one next action. A fully staffed result says no action is needed.

choices.label: Gloo composition is valid
Gloo fails or wording is invalid

nodes.title: Apply review, quiet hours and native checks
nodes.summary: Use the same consent, source, exact-review and native-delivery safeguards. A changed event start invalidates the old source.

choices.label: Native delivery is confirmed
Any required guard holds

nodes.title: Record the admin event update
nodes.summary: Keep actual delivery separate from queued/submitted state and retain deduplication evidence.
nodes.end: One factual event summary reaches the configured coordinator.

nodes.title: Reuse the existing event receipt
nodes.summary: Do not add a second status text because another scheduler tick ran.
nodes.end: No duplicate event digest is created.

nodes.title: Show the real blocker internally
nodes.summary: Paused scheduling, missing enrollment, invalid facts, Gloo trouble or delivery constraints remain visible rather than becoming a fake success.
nodes.end: The coordinator can inspect the readiness or review reason. No unsupported delivery claim.

flows.title: Personal care and ministry health
flows.summary: Sensitive messages and evidence-based workload flags create human decisions. They do not justify automatic pastoral advice or unsolicited follow-up.

nodes.title: Choose the source of the concern
nodes.summary: Personal distress from an actual message and capacity patterns from saved staffing history are separate evidence.

choices.label: An incoming message suggests personal distress
An internal capacity scan finds a pattern

nodes.title: Record a care hold and urgency signal
nodes.summary: Create a human follow-up and block routine automation to the sender. Urgency is an attention signal, not a diagnosis.

choices.label: There is also an explicit scheduling cancellation
No separate logistical action is clear

nodes.title: Preserve the separate logistical meaning
nodes.summary: An explicit cancellation can still reopen the right slot without automatically replying about the personal issue.

choices.label: The assignment is clear
The logistical target is uncertain

nodes.title: Is the concern supported by saved facts?
nodes.summary: Check workload, past participation, verified qualification expiry, role pool size, gaps and known future capacity.

choices.label: A defined evidence threshold is met
The facts are missing or threshold is unmet

nodes.title: Create or update a deduplicated internal flag
nodes.summary: Keep actual evidence and a suggested next action for overload, untapped people, unused skills, thin pools, growing need or imbalance.

choices.label: Coordinator reviews the finding

nodes.title: Choose a human next step
nodes.summary: The coordinator can review or dismiss a flag, verify a credential, or decide on a separately authorized conversation.

choices.label: A human follow-up is warranted
Dismiss or leave for later

nodes.title: A person owns the follow-up
nodes.summary: Exact-review care mode leaves the item with the coordinator and does not automatically contact a pastor. Existing sensitive holds remain enforced.
nodes.end: Human review handles care or ministry action. The model does not counsel, diagnose or send unsolicited outreach.

nodes.title: No automatic contact or staffing inference
nodes.summary: Unknown capacity is not zero; a dismissed flag is not new consent or qualification.
nodes.end: Retain valid evidence and continue ordinary guarded scheduling.

flows.title: Planning Center event and open-needs import
flows.summary: Read selected plans and authoritative service times. Signed webhook refreshes update the same data without importing consent or triggering outreach.

nodes.title: Verify organization and selected service types
nodes.summary: Use explicitly configured intended Planning Center scope and authenticated API access.

choices.label: Organization and scope match
Identity or scope does not match

nodes.title: Read plans, service PlanTimes and NeededPositions
nodes.summary: Actual service start/end values are authoritative. Plan sort dates are not shift times.

choices.label: Plan data is valid
Missing, ambiguous or failed API data

nodes.title: Upsert events and open role slots
nodes.summary: Repeated imports deduplicate events/shifts. Removed needs reconcile conservatively and existing assignment history is preserved.

choices.label: Import succeeds
Database update fails

nodes.title: Local schedule now shows imported needs
nodes.summary: This base importer does not import people, grant consent, create fill requests or send messages.

choices.label: A future webhook asks for refresh
Inspect imported coverage only

nodes.title: Verify raw-body HMAC, scope and delivery ID
nodes.summary: Accept only a valid signed relevant event for the selected organization/service types. Deduplicate EventDelivery IDs transactionally.

choices.label: Valid new relevant webhook
Duplicate or unrelated event
Invalid signature/scope or failed processing

nodes.title: Refresh current scoped plan facts
nodes.summary: Re-read API data and persist the relevant change. Processing failures remain retryable rather than acknowledging a false success.

choices.label: Refresh and durable receipt succeed
API or database fails

nodes.title: Schedule bridge is updated without outreach
nodes.summary: Successful plan import/webhook evidence is distinct from staffing-write readiness or native text delivery.
nodes.end: Imported events and needs are available for coordinator review. No recipient has been contacted.

nodes.title: Stop or request a legitimate retry
nodes.summary: Do not broaden organization scope, invent times or mark failed persistence as complete. A real failed webhook can retry through its normal mechanism.
nodes.end: Preserve existing records and expose the failure reason.

flows.title: Planning Center staffing synchronization
flows.summary: The staffing worker is implemented and synthetically tested, but writes/polling are off by default and live two-way staffing proof remains outstanding.

nodes.title: Is this explicitly mapped staffing sync activated?
nodes.summary: Runtime flags, intended organization, reviewed scope and needed database migration must be configured separately from ordinary scheduling.

choices.label: Authorized current activation and storage are ready
Flags off, migration missing or activation unverified

nodes.title: Verify exact person, position and service time mappings
nodes.summary: Use an existing verified Services Person and reviewed team/position/PlanTime mappings. Never infer identity from a similar name.

choices.label: All mappings match current remote facts
Mapping absent, ambiguous or changed

nodes.title: Capture an authoritative local transition
nodes.summary: A confirmation or cancellation queues in the same local transaction. Existing history requires a bounded explicit catch-up.

choices.label: A new confirmed/cancelled transition is durable
Identity-only signup or no real staffing transition

nodes.title: Fresh-read remote and local prerequisites
nodes.summary: Check consent, eligibility, plan/time/team/position, current membership, reservations and open needs. A replacement depends on verified prior cancellation.

choices.label: All facts and dependencies are current
Conflict, occupied need or unresolved cancellation

nodes.title: Lease the plan and persist unknown before HTTP
nodes.summary: Commit the guarded intent before a remote write so a crash cannot invite a blind second create.

choices.label: Lease and durable intent are secured
Another worker owns it or state is uncertain

nodes.title: Write with notification preparation disabled
nodes.summary: Use documented create/update operations with notification-preparation fields off, then preserve returned identity durably.

choices.label: Response identity is known
Timeout or unknown result

nodes.title: Verify exact identity, status and silent fields
nodes.summary: Fresh remote readback must match the intended person/position/status and notification fields. Other account automations still need a separate live no-notification check.

choices.label: Readback matches all required facts
Readback conflicts or fails

nodes.title: Count only verified remote confirmation as covered
nodes.summary: C plus a confirmed local assignment with no unresolved latest intent can count. U remains reserved/unconfirmed.
nodes.end: Record verified sync state. Live staffing acceptance and open-needs behavior still require separate authorized proof.

nodes.title: Reconcile without replaying an uncertain create
nodes.summary: Read the known response ID when available. Missing or conflicting outcomes remain held; do not reset to pending to force a retry.
nodes.end: Keep the saga visibly partial and preserve cancellation/assignment history.

nodes.title: Leave staffing unchanged for review
nodes.summary: No live write is authorized merely by exploring this decision tree or toggling a demo branch.
nodes.end: Resolve exact activation, mapping or state requirements before any separately authorized live worker action.
